description: This file constructs and manages message objects for reporting CRUD (create, update, delete) events about sensors to a server, including formatting messages and cleanup functions.

methods.name: formatSensorCrudMessageFormatter
methods.description: Formats a sensor CRUD message into a string buffer for transmission.

methods.name: sensorCrudMessageDestroyFunc
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with a sensor CRUD message, including freeing the Sensor object.

methods.name: formatSensorRemoveMessageFormatter
methods.description: Formats a sensor removal message showing only the endpoint ID.

methods.name: sensorRemoveMessageDestroyFunc
methods.description: Cleans up resources for a sensor removal message, freeing the endpoint ID string.

methods.name: createSensorAddedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a new sensor has been added.

methods.name: createSensorRemovedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a sensor has been removed.

methods.name: createSensorUpdatedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a sensor has been updated.

methods.name: createSensorFaultRestoreMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a sensor fault or restore event.
